name: 8051 Addition Example
desc:
This is a simple 8051 assembly language program that adds two 8-bit numbers and stores the result in internal RAM. The program starts at the reset vector (address 0000H) and performs the following steps:

1. Load the first number (25H) into Register 0 (R0).
2. Load the second number (34H) into the Accumulator (A).
3. Add the content of R0 to the Accumulator.
4. Store the final result in RAM address 30H.
5. End the program.

This program demonstrates basic arithmetic operations and data storage in the 8051 microcontroller.

files.sketch.asm:
ORG 0000H         ; Reset vector (program starts here)
MOV R0, #25H      ; Load first number (25H) into Register 0
MOV A, #34H       ; Load second number (34H) into Accumulator
ADD A, R0         ; Add content of R0 to Accumulator (A = A + R0)
MOV 30H, A        ; Store the final result in RAM address 30H
END               ; End of the program

;This program adds two 8-bit numbers stored in registers and 
;saves the result in internal RAM location 30H
